<!-- pr-reviewer: 8fd07dc77e2dc4eef3304f45593a50b747faf4e6 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** (Replacement for #1310; the earlier needs-rework review there is addressed on this head.)

**Earlier blockers on #1310**
- PROCESS_VERSION must exceed main: now 60, main is 58 (open #1418 holds 59, so whichever of the two merges second takes the next number). Addressed.
- `xtask/src/main.rs` mod block conflict: resolved; the trial merge of this head with main (9dad56ea) is clean. Addressed.
- rustfmt-only reflow widening the conflict surface (a note): still present in `braces.rs`/`main.rs`, not blocking.

**What looks good**
- Diff is the PR's own 13 files under `xtask/`, `docs/decisions/927-directory-test-suites.md` and PROCESS_VERSION. No dependencies, build.rs, `.github/`, scripts, snapshots or goldens touched.
- Decision file present; Fixes #927 and Changelog line in the body; process change carries the bump.

**Local results (merged with main, Windows)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p xtask` | 112 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `gate batch --dry-run` vs main's | identical plan (same suites and binaries; only the worktree path differs) |

**Notes (not blocking)**
- New test files `directory_tests.rs` (394 lines) and `quick.rs` (396) sit just under the ~400-line limit.
- Not exercised: application, full and release suites, other platforms. The pr-test runner refuses `xtask/`, so this was built locally.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- review-cost: 8fd07dc77e2dc4eef3304f45593a50b747faf4e6 -->
**Estimated agent cost to merge-ready:** ~$0.48 (171k tokens)
| Run | Model | Tokens | Est. cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| replacement branch (merge of main) | Sonnet 5.5 | 87k | ~$0.24 |
| review | Sonnet 5.5 | 84k | ~$0.24 |
Blended upper estimate (90 % input / 10 % output at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower). Main-session coordination and the earlier reviews of PR 1310 are not counted.
